diagnosis: user_portfolio_summary uses @cache_page(60 * 15) on an authenticated per-user view without @vary_on_cookie or @vary_on_headers('Authorization'). Django generates the cache key solely based on the URL path. When User A requests their portfolio summary, the response is stored in the shared cache. For the next 15 minutes, any other authenticated user navigating to /api/v1/portfolio/summary/ receives User A's private account holder details, bank account number, and total wealth balance.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary/ HTTP/1.1
Host: banking.wealthmanagement.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session_cookie_772
Accept: application/json
